name: Ostrom design principles
interaction_evidence: Long-enduring commons share the eight principles (Ostrom 1990); the principles are well supported across 91 studies (Cox et al. 2010).

name: Covenants with a sword
interaction_evidence: Communication alone improves yields; communication plus self-chosen sanctioning is near-optimal; imposed sanctioning alone is overused.

name: Carrot and stick
interaction_evidence: Andreoni et al.: combination most effective, rewards and punishment are complements. Sefton et al.: combination gives the highest contributions.

name: Communication before punishment
interaction_evidence: Communication improves outcomes; punishment without communication does not.

name: Gossip and ostracism
interaction_evidence: Gossip plus ostracism produces the highest cooperation.

name: Fine replacing a social norm
interaction_evidence: Late arrivals increased after a fine was introduced and stayed high after it was removed.

name: Punishment with counter-punishment
interaction_evidence: Fear of retaliation reduces punishment, and cooperation falls relative to punishment-only treatments.

name: Monitoring with conditional cooperators
interaction_evidence: Groups with more conditional cooperators invest more in patrols and have more productive forests.

name: Antitrust enforcement package
interaction_evidence: Leniency strengthens deterrence; rewards drive prices to competitive levels.

name: Deposit-refund (tax plus subsidy)
interaction_evidence: Deposit-refund reaches the waste target at about half the cost of disposal fees or recycling subsidies alone (simulation).

name: Extralegal merchant order
interaction_evidence: Unpaid arbitration awards are posted publicly and lead to expulsion and boycott; the system handles nearly all disputes more cheaply than courts.

name: Peer pressure in partnerships
interaction_evidence: Theoretical: guilt and shame work through mutual monitoring.

name: Twitch moderation toolkit
interaction_evidence: Users imitated observed behavior, more from high-status users; proactive chat modes discouraged spam.

name: Token governance with timelock and guardian
Agent self-governance in a commons (GovSim-SelfGovern)
interaction_evidence: Catch caps dominate but fail under scarcity; survival in fatal scenarios requires fiscal reserves or exile.

name: Reputation network (RepuNet)
interaction_evidence: Reputation avoids cooperation collapse; exploitative agents become socially isolated.

name: Cooperation mechanism benchmark (CoopEval)
interaction_evidence: Contracting and mediation were most effective; repetition deteriorates with varying co-players.

name: Collusion mitigations for pricing agents
interaction_evidence: Prompt-only warnings reduce but do not eliminate above-Nash pricing; an expected-damages regulator brings prices close to competitive.

name: Punishment with strategy imitation
interaction_evidence: Explicit punishment drives norm emergence; reluctant cooperators switch after being punished.

name: Punishment, partner selection and reputation (MARL)
interaction_evidence: The effect of direct punishment depends on how it combines with third-party punishment, partner selection and reputation.
